note: Type 2 LOOPs page: rotated loops that travel between alpha/beta and gamma via Type 2 connector letters. Recipe: loopType rotated + smooth + no-dash + startPlacement in the slot's family; travel through gamma verified per candidate (no direct constraint exists). Slots keyed by the start family of the page's three print examples (BΣTX alpha, EΔUZ beta, OYHΘ gamma).

alpha-gamma.defaultEntry: BΣTX (original print example, stays default; entry-0 prose drafted at migration)

candidates.prose: KΩXC uses Ω and X to dip through gamma and come back. The left hand keeps moving counter-clockwise the whole way while the right rests through both Type 2 steps.
verified: red static on steps 2,3,6,7 (the Ω and X steps)
blue rotates ccw on all 8 steps
red moving steps (1,4,5,8) all cw
route per half: alpha→beta→gamma→alpha

candidates.prose: BBΔW warms up with two B steps, then Δ sends the right hand out to gamma and W brings it home while the left holds still. Every rotation in the word is counter-clockwise.
verified: blue static on steps 3,4,7,8 (the Δ and W steps)
every moving rotation ccw (both hands)
gamma visited on steps 3 and 7
B steps (1,2,5,6) anti on both hands

candidates.prose: In ΣYFB the right hand does a full lap: Σ lifts it to gamma, Y drops it to beta, then F and B walk it back through alpha. The left joins in only for the back half of each word.
verified: blue static on steps 1,2 and 5,6 (the Σ and Y steps)
red moves on all 8 steps, every rotation cw
route per half: alpha→gamma→beta→alpha
blue moving steps (3,4,7,8) all cw

candidates.prose: CΔZD tours all three position families: Δ climbs from alpha to gamma, Z drops to beta, and D carries both hands back. The left hand rests through the two Type 2 crossings.
verified: blue static on steps 2,3,6,7 (the Δ and Z steps)
red moves on all 8 steps, every rotation cw
each half visits alpha, gamma, and beta
blue moving steps (1,4,5,8) all ccw
